body.content: Consider the 'Checklist Paradox': as a checklist becomes more comprehensive to capture expert intuition, it becomes so cumbersome that non-experts stop treating it as a reasoning tool and start treating it as a bureaucratic hurdle, thereby increasing the rate of 'compliance errors' (checking a box without verifying the condition).
body.why_keep_this: Explores the failure mode of the panel approach as the checklist scales.
